notes: Book is already balanced across all four regimes with no quadrant above forty percent; using a sliver of the idle cash to add a small inflation-protected bond position, everything else unchanged.

rule_cited: The Four Quadrants framework; Diversification is the holy grail
teach: Spreading money across the four growth-and-inflation combinations protects you when any one of them turns out wrong.
why: Inflation-protected bonds fell about one and a half percent this month while stocks fell three percent, so adding a little balances the mix.
